standard_prerequisites.name: Ampleness and Proj comparison on a curve
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Varieties, Lemma varieties-lemma-ample-curve; Morphisms, Lemma morphisms-lemma-proper-ample-is-proj; Constructions, Lemma constructions-lemma-surjective-graded-rings-generated-degree-1-map-proj

core_obligations: Riemann-Roch identity dim H^0(X, L) - dim H^1(X, L) = d + 1 (proof lines 2030-2034); the zero scheme D of a nonzero section is an effective Cartier divisor with L = O_X(D) and the exact sequence 0 -> O_X -> L -> L|_D -> 0.

Since H^1(X, O_X) = 0 the connecting map shows H^0(X, L) -> H^0(X, L|_D) is surjective; L|_D is globally generated (dim D = 0) and even trivial (D Artinian, Divisors, Lemma divisors-lemma-finite-trivialize-invertible-upstairs), so a section t trivializing L|_D exists; the sequence also kills H^1(X, L) (proof lines 2036-2060).

Multiplication maps mu_n : H^0(L) x H^0(L^tensor n) -> H^0(L^tensor n+1) are surjective for n >= 1 (proof lines 2063-2088): sections from the left of 0 -> L^tensor n -> L^tensor n+1 -> L^tensor n+1|_D -> 0 are in the image, and mu_n(H^0(L) tensor t^n) covers the quotient supported on D.

L is ample (varieties-lemma-ample-curve), so X = Proj of the section ring (morphisms-lemma-proper-ample-is-proj); surjectivity of all mu_n makes the ring a quotient of a polynomial algebra in d+1 variables, hence a closed immersion X -> P^d_k (proof lines 2090-2110, with the author's remark that compatibility with constructions-lemma-projective-space is omitted as a verification).
proof_roadmap: Write the degree-genus identity and the section-sequence 0 -> O_X -> L -> L|_D -> 0.
Use H^1(O_X) = 0 and the triviality of L|_D to get H^0(L) = d+1 and H^1(L) = 0.
Prove surjectivity of every multiplication map mu_n by splitting sections along the divisor sequence.
Conclude with ampleness, the Proj identification, and the closed immersion into P^d_k.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the complete section behaviour of a positive-degree sheaf on a genus 0 curve (statement lines 2018-2028). The proof (lines 2030-2105) is an honest computation: the Cartier divisor sequence attached to a section, the triviality of L|_D over the Artinian zero scheme, the vanishing of H^1, the surjectivity of the multiplication maps proved by dividing sections along D, and the final Proj comparison producing the embedding. H2: all ingredients are standard, but the division-of-sections step and the graded-algebra bookkeeping must be done in the right order.
